ui.chat.credential_notice.armed.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text.
ui.chat.credential_notice.armed.role: composer status line after /credential is typed
ui.chat.credential_notice.armed.tone: lowercase clause with an em dash, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.chip_title.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text.

placeholders.index: the pill's ordinal in the message
placeholders.chars: how many characters the secret has; renders as #

ui.chat.credential_notice.chip_title.role: tooltip of a credential pill in the composer
ui.chat.credential_notice.chip_title.tone: label, count, em dash, clause, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.clear_label.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text.

placeholders.index: the pill's ordinal in the message

ui.chat.credential_notice.clear_label.role: accessible name of the control that removes a credential pill
ui.chat.credential_notice.clear_label.tone: imperative verb phrase, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.cleared.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text. /credential is a command and stays literal.

placeholders.key: the credential's variable name; shown verbatim
placeholders.index: the pill's ordinal in the message
placeholders.undoCap: the undo shortcut as displayed (⌘Z or Ctrl+Z); never translated

ui.chat.credential_notice.cleared.role: notice after the user removes a credential pill from the message
ui.chat.credential_notice.cleared.tone: two sentences with an em dash, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.discarded.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text.
ui.chat.credential_notice.discarded.role: composer status line after a secret was discarded
ui.chat.credential_notice.discarded.tone: lowercase clause with an em dash, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span.note: Enter is a key name and stays literal.
ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span.role: composer status line when the masked span is empty
ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span.tone: lowercase clause with an em dash, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span_dra.note: Enter is a key name and /credential a command; both stay literal.
ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span_dra.role: composer status line when the masked span is empty in a new chat
ui.chat.credential_notice.empty_span_dra.tone: lowercase clause with an em dash, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.escape_held.note: Esc and Enter are key names and stay literal.
ui.chat.credential_notice.escape_held.role: composer status line after the first Escape on a secret
ui.chat.credential_notice.escape_held.tone: capitalised clause with an em dash, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.operator_move.note: /credential is a command and stays literal.
ui.chat.credential_notice.operator_move.role: remedy sentence for a credential whose save could not be confirmed
ui.chat.credential_notice.operator_move.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.typing.note: Enter and Esc are key names and stay literal; a pill is the small chip a stored secret becomes.
ui.chat.credential_notice.typing.role: composer status line while a secret is being typed
ui.chat.credential_notice.typing.tone: lowercase clause with an em dash, no full stop

ui.chat.credential_notice.unconfirmed_al.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text.
ui.chat.credential_notice.unconfirmed_al.role: label of a credential chip with no variable name, saying the store could not confirm the save

placeholders.key: the credential's variable name; shown verbatim

ui.chat.credential_notice.unconfirmed_la.role: label of a named credential chip whose save could not be confirmed

ui.chat.credential_notice.unconfirmed_wo.note: A credential is a secret (API key, token) the user types or pastes into the composer; it is masked and stored by name, never sent as text.
ui.chat.credential_notice.unconfirmed_wo.role: words on a credential chip saying the store could not confirm the secret was saved

ui.chat.credential_notice.undo.note: Use the same word as the app's other Undo buttons.
ui.chat.credential_notice.undo.role: action label on the removed-credential notice

ui.chat.credential_notice.unredacted.note: Enter is a key name and stays literal.

placeholders.length: how many characters were unmasked; renders as #

ui.chat.credential_notice.unredacted.role: warning after masked characters were turned into ordinary text
ui.chat.credential_notice.unredacted.tone: clause with an em dash, no full stop; PLAIN TEXT is deliberately emphasised
